verdict.rationale: Zapier MCP documents connection-token-based auth, a toggle between 'agentic' and 'managed' modes that restricts which actions an agent can call, server-level access controls for teammates, and SOC2/OAuth-backed security — all of which support issuing scoped, governed credentials for an agent to use across 9,000+ apps. However, the evidence never details fine-grained per-agent or per-scope credential minting (e.g., selecting individual actions/apps at token-creation time) or independent verification that these controls actually enforce least privilege in practice. Missing for 10: granular scope-selection UI/API for credential issuance, and independent/hands-on confirmation that managed-mode restrictions are enforced as claimed.
